offering_description.value: Operates online auctions for salvage and used vehicles, selling mainly insurance-written-off cars to dealers, dismantlers, rebuilders and exporters. Collects vehicles from insurers, fleets and dealers, stores them at yards, and sells them through its web-based bidding platform.

primary_products.value: salvage vehicles; used vehicles (sold at auction)

primary_services.value: online vehicle auctions; vehicle remarketing; towing and transport; vehicle storage and title handling

customer_segment.value: B2B: Insurers, fleet and rental companies, dealers as sellers, dismantlers, rebuilders, dealers and exporters as buyers; B2C: Individual buyers and consumer vehicle sellers

end_markets.value: automotive remarketing; auto insurance; used vehicle sales; auto recycling and parts; vehicle export

revenue_model.value: service fees: seller fees, buyer fees, and vehicle handling, storage, towing and title services; product sales: vehicles purchased and resold at auction

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in vehicles from insurers and fleets, sells via auction to dealers and dismantlers; software / platform: online bidding marketplace connecting sellers and buyers; asset operator: owns and runs vehicle storage yards
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: US, Canada, UK, Brazil, Germany, Spain, UAE, Oman, Bahrain, Ireland and others, buyers in 190+ countries

specialization.value: niche specialist: online vehicle auctions and related remarketing services

distribution_channels.value: online: web and mobile auction platform for bidding; own locations: yards holding vehicles for inspection and pickup; direct sales: relationships with insurers and fleet sellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Vehicle title, salvage and dealer licensing rules by state, environmental rules at yards, data privacy
